title: Enhancement: PDDF  get num_components fail when use new pddf_chassis.
author: jostar-yang
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

PDDF in community SONiC get num_components fail.
New pddf_chassis  is not generic for show firmware version. It cause original component.py fail when use PDDF.

### Current Behavior

 I git cone community SONiC to verify pddf work or not for least code. But I find below ,

root@sonic:/home/admin# show interfaces status
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/intfutil", line 932, in <module>
    main()
  File "/usr/local/bin/intfutil", line 912, in main
    interface_stat.display_intf_status()
  File "/usr/local/bin/intfutil", line 484, in display_intf_status
    self.get_intf_status()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/utilities_common/multi_asic.py", line 153, in wrapped_run_on_all_asics
    func(self,  *args, **kwargs)
  File "/usr/local/bin/intfutil", line 571, in get_intf_status
    self.table += self.generate_intf_status()
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/bin/intfutil", line 515, in generate_intf_status
    port_oper_speed_get(self.db, key),
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/bin/intfutil", line 211, in port_oper_speed_get
    return appl_db_port_status_get(db, intf_name, PORT_SPEED)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/bin/intfutil", line 176, in appl_db_port_status_get
    optics_type = port_optics_get(appl_db, intf_name, PORT_OPTICS_TYPE)
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/bin/intfutil", line 233, in port_optics_get
    if is_rj45_port(intf_name):
       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/utilities_common/platform_sfputil_helper.py", line 313, in is_rj45_port
    platform_chassis = sonic_platform.platform.Platform().get_chassis()
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform/platform.py", line 23, in __init__
    PddfPlatform.__init__(self)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform_pddf_base/pddf_platform.py", line 36, in __init__
    self._chassis = Chassis(self.pddf_data, self.pddf_plugin_data)
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform/chassis.py", line 30, in __init__
    PddfChassis.__init__(self, pddf_data, pddf_plugin_data)
 File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform_pddf_base/pddf_chassis.py", line 117, in __init__
    for i in range(self.platform_inventory['num_components']):
                   ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
KeyError: 'num_components'



Community pddf_chassis:

component_present = True
try:
    from sonic_platform.component import Component
except ImportError as e:
    component_present = False
….
component_present = True
try:
    from sonic_platform.component import Component
except ImportError as e:
    component_present = False
……
def __init__(self, pddf_data=None, pddf_plugin_data=None):    
……..
        if component_present:
            # Components (Programmables)
            for i in range(self.platform_inventory['num_components']):
                component = Component(i, self.pddf_obj, self.plugin_data)
                self._component_list.append(component)


We should follow BRCM's  pddf_chassis: (It can support current componeny.py or use pddf-device.json)

        if 'num_components' in self.platform_inventory:
           from sonic_platform.component import Component 
           for i in range(self.platform_inventory['num_components']):
               component = Component(i, self.pddf_obj, self.plugin_data)
               self._component_list.append(component)


### Proposed Behavior

We should follow BRCM's  pddf_chassis: (It can support current componeny.py or use pddf-device.json)

        if 'num_components' in self.platform_inventory:
           from sonic_platform.component import Component 
           for i in range(self.platform_inventory['num_components']):
               component = Component(i, self.pddf_obj, self.plugin_data)
               self._component_list.append(component)

#### Why I did it
#Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/24325
- Avoid pddf_chassis.py requiring the following fields defined in pddf-device.json
   - num_fantrays
   - num_psus
   - num_ports
   - num_temps
   - num_voltage_sensors
   - num_current_sensors
   - num_asic_temps
   - num_components

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
- Default to 0 whenever a num_* field is missing.
